Body.Content:
What and Why:

Copilot Notebooks is evolving into Copilot Workspaces with new collaboration capabilities that help teams coordinate work context and progress more effectively.

This update adds collaborative workspace features including an activity feed, suggested workspaces, team presence, group ownership, and adding a Project as a reference files.

Rollout Schedule:

Frontier Public: began in November 2026.

General Availability (Worldwide): expected to begin in December 2026.

Impact on Your Organization:

Users with access to Copilot Workspaces in Frontier will see expanded collaboration capabilities and updated workspace behaviors.

This can affect user workflows and adoption/training materials where Copilot Notebooks guidance is currently documented.

Action Required/Recommendations:

No immediate admin action is required. We recommend notifying impacted users about the Workspaces evolution and updating enablement documentation as needed.

Compliance considerations:

No compliance considerations identified, review as appropriate for your organization.
